label: Acoustic Folk
blueprintGuidance: Represent acoustic folk: lyric-first writing, natural performance, and simple harmonic movement.
Keep the hook plainspoken and memorable.
Use mood input for warmth, loneliness, road, room, rain, morning, or nostalgia.
generationGuidance: Use fingerpicked or softly strummed acoustic guitar, light piano accents, gentle room percussion, and warm natural vocal tone.
Keep the arrangement small, human, and centered on the words.
Add subtle harmony only in the hook or final repeat.
Avoid long intros and enter with guitar plus vocal quickly for short-form output.
avoidGuidance: Avoid glossy pop drums, dominant synth pads, cinematic strings, and heavy bass.
Avoid dramatic modulations or full-band rock-ballad energy.
